variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: TRG-22 Kit
variants.info: A conversion kit to transform your gun into the TRG-22, firing the .260 Remington cartridge. Less power, more maneuverability. Comes with a brand new bolt to make cycling much easier!

variants.name: .338 Norma
variants.info: Loads your TRG with .338 Norma Magnum. This cartridge was developed to surpass the performance of .338 Lapua Magnum. Having a shorter cartridge length. While it does not travel as fast and torso kill as far, it focuses on improving your firing speed!

variants.name: TRG-S Kit
variants.info: A conversion kit that transforms the gun into the TRG-S, firing the famed .30-06 cartridge. Trades performance at range for a significantly long one-shot kill to any part of the body.
